newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA LEAVE ENGLAND NEEDING RECORD 469 TO WIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA LEAVE ENGLAND NEEDING RECORD 469 TO WIN.

text.p: Australia left England with a mountain to climb after declaring their second innings at 395 for eight on the fourth day of the third test on Sunday.
The visitors left England needing to score a world record 469 for victory in just over four-and-a-half sessions.
No team in test history has made more than 406 to win a match in the fourth innings.
Steve Waugh became the first player for 50 years to score a century in each innings of an Ashes test as Australia piled on the runs.
Waugh scored 116 in six hours 20 minutes at the crease before being caught by wicket-keeper Alec Stewart.
Australia looked well-placed to level the six-match series at one each with three to play. The second test was drawn.
Scores: Australia 235 and 395 for eight declared. England 162.
